subject: Activate MAP: NovaGen goals, stakeholders, and close timeline
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@novagen.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Activate MAP: NovaGen goals, stakeholders, and close timeline

Hi Maya —

Great to meet you on the call last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align goals, stakeholders, and a realistic timeline to close the pilot. The MAP starter attached is intended to be lightweight: a single sheet with owners, decisions, and target dates so we can move quickly.

High-level goals (proposed):
- Goal 1: Validate Redwood inference integration with NovaGen's annotation pipeline for release candidate models (success metric: end-to-end latency < 250ms P95 on sample dataset)
- Goal 2: Demonstrate cost/per-token improvement vs current infra with a 2-week production-like run
- Goal 3: Complete security/compliance checklist for procurement sign-off

Suggested timeline (draft):
- Week 1 (Apr 12–16): Kickoff, access provisioning, baseline metrics collection
- Week 2–3 (Apr 19–30): Integration + smoke tests, first eval run
- Week 4 (May 3–7): Analyze results, stakeholder review, procurement enablement

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm the primary champion for program decisions (I have you listed).
2) Can you confirm the internal stakeholders who should be on the MAP (technical, security, procurement)?
3) Does Apr 14 at 10:00 AM PT work for a 60-minute kickoff? If not, propose 2 alternatives.

Attachments: NovaGen_MAP_Starter_v1.xlsx, 30-60-90-eval-timeline.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3492

CC'ing Lauren (Solutions Engineering) and Soojin (Customer Success) so they can scope the technical kick-off. Lauren will cover model integration, Soojin will run the onboarding timeline and success criteria.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Maya Patel <m.patel@novagen.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Lee <james.lee@novagen.com>, Tara Gomez <tara@novagen.com>
Date: 2027-04-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activate MAP: NovaGen goals, stakeholders, and close timeline

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. I'm happy to be the program champion. A couple quick updates from our side:

- Please add James Lee (data science) — he'll lead the model validation work.
- I'll loop in Tara from procurement for contract/timing questions (cc'd).
- Please also include our security lead, Elena Ruiz (elena.ruiz@novagen.com) on the MAP — she will need to review the checklist during week 2.

The timeline looks reasonable. Apr 14 at 10:00 AM PT conflicts with an exec all-hands on our side. Would Apr 15 at 1:00 PM PT or Apr 16 at 9:00 AM PT work for you?

I've attached a short internal evaluation criteria doc (nova_gen_eval_criteria.docx) that lists the dataset slices we'll use for the smoke test so your team can review.

Looking forward to the kickoff — I want to make sure procurement has clear acceptance criteria so we can move quickly to a pilot PO if the results look good.

Best,
Maya Patel
Head of ML Programs | NovaGen Therapeutics
m.patel@novagen.com | +1 (617) 555-0987

Date: 2027-04-08T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activate MAP: NovaGen goals, stakeholders, and close timeline

Thanks, Maya —

Apr 15 at 1:00 PM PT works for us. I've booked a 60-minute kickoff and sent a calendar invite (you should see it shortly). Agenda for the kickoff:

1) Introductions & roles (10 mins) — confirm MAP owners and decision makers
2) Review success criteria and eval slices (15 mins) — James to confirm datasets
3) Access & infra readiness (15 mins) — Lauren to outline steps for credentials and test environment
4) Timeline & next steps (15 mins) — owners for Week 1 tasks, procurement timeline

Action items before the kickoff:
- I will update the MAP starter sheet with the stakeholders you named and post a link to the Drive.
- Lauren will review the nova_gen_eval_criteria.docx and call out any gaps by EOD Apr 12.
- Soojin will prepare a short onboarding checklist we can follow during Week 1.

Attachments: NovaGen_MAP_Starter_v1.xlsx (updated will be shared via Drive), 30-60-90-eval-timeline.pdf
Related: https://drive.redwood.ai/file/d/1a2b3cMAPstarter

If there are any other folks who should be on the kickoff (security, legal), please forward the invite — happy to expand.

See you on Apr 15.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
H: +1 (415) 555-0124 | hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
